formats.phi: 1 sign + 4 exponent (bias 7) + 3 mantissa; midpoint quanta over [1, phi)
formats.int8: symmetric -127..127 calibrated to dataset range R=3.62327

config.ingest_policy: each dataset value quantized once (cold cache); total shared across the task
config.error_metric: per-dot |y_hat - y| / ||y_ref||_2 (shared reference scale over all dots — robust vs a per-dot denominator, which is unstable for near-zero 32-term dot products); err_per_op = total rel err / total ops
config.mac_ops_counted: live per format: phi = sign xor + exponent add + mass add per pair, carries (div+mul+sub+add), fold (mul+add per level); fp8/int8 = mul+add per pair + 1 dequant scale
config.hist_bin_policy: phi bins from its own code field (0 ops); fp8/int8 via precomputed code->bin LUT (storage, not ops)
config.mass_product_policy: plan-faithful: the exact product of the two quantized mantissas is the added mass (64-valued one-time table); no per-product re-quantization; re-quantization only via Fibonacci-carry division and the final fold
config.verdict_rule: adopt iff (1) phi MAC err_per_op(ingest-incl) <= 0.9 * min(fp8,int8) AND (2) phi hist L1 <= max(fp8,int8) L1 AND (3) phi ops_per_result(ingest-incl) <= min(fp8,int8); else reject. Experiment passes on producing an explicit verdict with documented margin (P8: reject is a valid outcome).
